Optimal.Notes: Smooth, stable 60 fps at native resolution with a moderate TDP cap — the game is very light so this is the sweet spot for most players. Integer scaling keeps the hand-drawn art sharp.

profiles.Summary: Hollow Knight is a lightweight 2D indie game that runs excellently on the Steam Deck, easily hitting 60 fps with headroom to spare at native resolution. The Deck's hardware far exceeds the game's requirements, so battery life and comfort are the main tuning levers rather than raw performance.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC requirements (GTX 560 Ti minimum) and the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU, which vastly outclasses them. On first run, verify the in-game frame-rate cap setting name — Team Cherry's Unity build may label it differently — and confirm 60 fps holds in the most particle-heavy boss fights.

MaxBattery.Notes: A 4 W TDP and low GPU clock are more than sufficient for this 2D game; the 30 fps cap keeps power draw minimal. Integer scaling preserves the pixel-art aesthetic cleanly at native resolution.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Uncapped with all settings maxed; the game will still pin 60 fps effortlessly since it is far below the Deck's capability. Removing the TDP limit lets the APU boost freely, but gains are marginal for a 2D title.
MaxPerformance.ExpectedFps: 60+ fps (uncapped, typically pegged at display max)

Optimal.Notes: 60 fps is rock-solid for this game at a modest TDP; the hand-drawn art looks excellent at native 1280x800 with Integer scaling. This is the recommended everyday profile.

profiles.Summary: Hollow Knight is a lightweight 2D indie game that runs exceptionally well on the Steam Deck, easily hitting 60 fps and beyond with minimal hardware demands. The game is Steam Deck Verified with full controller support, and the OLED screen's vivid colors complement its hand-drawn art style beautifully.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC requirements (GTX 560 Ti minimum), its 2D hand-drawn engine, and the Deck hardware. On your first run, confirm the frame counter is stable in a busy boss arena — it almost certainly will be, but if the in-game framerate cap interferes with the Deck's limiter, disable it in-game and rely solely on the Quick Access cap.

MaxBattery.Notes: A very low TDP is sufficient for this lightweight 2D game; Integer scaling keeps the pixel art crisp at native resolution. Battery life is exceptional at this profile.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Hollow Knight is light enough to sustain 90 fps on the OLED's full refresh rate; the higher GPU clock ensures headroom during busy particle-heavy boss fights. Battery life drops noticeably but the silky-smooth feel is a treat on the OLED panel.
